lines.text: 3.4VegetationofDifferentClimaticRegions
Vegetation refers to plant community that grows over an area naturally. We know that world has
been divided in different climatic regions. Each region has its unique temperature and
precipitationcharacteristics.Vegetationofeachclimaticregionisalsodistinct.Thisis theproof
that climate is most important factorto determine the vegetation type.
Temperature and rainfall are major climatic elements. These are very important factors that
determine type of the vegetation of a place. We observe different types of vegetation in different
areas and these variations in vegetation are primarily due to variations in temperature and
rainfall. We have studied earlier about different.types of climatic regions in the world, now we are
going to examine different types of vegetation found in the above mentioned climatic regions.
I).Vegetation of Tropical Rainforest:
Tropical rainforest consistsoftalltrees
whose branches intermingle at the top
to form a canopy. Canopy is formed to
shields the lower layers of forest from
severe sunlight, drying winds, and
heavy rainfall, and to hold the
moisture of the forest below. This
canopy stops sunlight from penetrating
to the ground.Theseforests areknown
as Selvas. The vegetation of Selvas
comprises deciduous trees, such as
mahogany, ebony and dyewoods. The
tallest trees attain heights close to
50 m. The ground of the forest area is
covered with thick under growth as the
soil isrichin humus.
